bug_probe.title: R15 dummies walk into every prop from 4 sides (shared/PropCollision inventory, both halves)

note: B9 (advisory): luau/b9_prop_walk reads ReplicatedStorage.Shared.PropCollision.ENTRIES, so Gojo adds entries there and the probe walks them with no edit. Per kind PASS / FAIL / n/a / off: collidable part, fidelity, no spawn or prop placement inside, and an R15 dummy at WalkSpeed 16 from +-X / +-Z must not end inside or pass through (HARD for Jolt and already-collidable Gojo kinds, soft otherwise)
